spec_match.rationale: Composes a real exportKeyingMaterial call (label, context, outputLength) and fires it on a real session; the server-side panel states the matching recipe including Chromium's CONNECT-stream-ID context detail from the ChromeStatus summary.

interactive.rationale: Three live-updating inputs drive a preview of the exact call (with byte counts), and a button constructs a session and performs the real export, reporting the genuine outcome.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises composing a call, firing it, and the server recipe; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Separates RangeError (argument validation), InvalidStateError (dead endpoint), resolved-bytes (live endpoint), no-WebTransport and method-absent, each with distinct honest wording; no bytes are fabricated when the endpoint is unreachable.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4860330806214656 and RFC 5705; crumbs reach the full feature reference list.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's RangeError, InvalidStateError and NewObject assertions cover the contracts this page exercises.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the call preview updated live (byte counts recomputed after editing the label), the fire button reported the method absent with local byte validation shown; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: the resolved-bytes path needs a 158+ build and a live HTTP/3 endpoint.

telemetry_health.rationale: wt-ekm-designer-ran / method-missing / no-wt asserts cover the branches; the export is awaited with all rejections caught.

design_system.rationale: Inputs and preview use ivory surfaces with text-black at AA; result output on bg-stone.

accessibility.rationale: Every input has a label and an aria-describedby hint, the fire button is native, the result is aria-live=polite; the server pseudocode is a focusable pre.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Exercise a resolved export against a live endpoint on Chrome 158+
openQuestions.detail: With a reachable HTTP/3 WebTransport server and a 158+ build, verify the composed call resolves with the requested bytes and that the server's matching export (including the CONNECT stream ID in context) yields the identical value.

guidanceConsulted.query: channel binding keying material client server derivation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never transmit the derived material; send an HMAC over a challenge, and keep server/client derivations aligned.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The server panel sends HMAC(material, challenge), not the material, and documents the CONNECT-stream-ID context so both ends align; the client call is real and never fabricates bytes.

guidanceConsulted.query: form inputs labels hints live region result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every field, attach hints with aria-describedby, announce async results politely.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each of the three inputs has a visible label and an aria-describedby hint; the outcome is a single aria-live=polite output.

summary: Channel-binding composer: live call preview with byte counts, a real export fired on a real session, and the matching server recipe. Driven on headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): live preview edit verified, honest method-absent outcome, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
